description: This file contains functions for retrieving various code snippets for an IDE, including recent edits, clipboard content, open files, and static snippets, with support for asynchronous operations and race conditions.

methods.name: racePromise
methods.description: Wraps a promise with a timeout, racing the promise against a timeout to return an empty array if timeout occurs.

methods.name: getIdeSnippets
methods.description: Fetches IDE snippets using LSP, optionally filtering to workspace files.

methods.name: getSnippetsFromRecentlyEditedRanges
methods.description: Returns snippets from recently edited ranges if enabled.

methods.name: getSnippetsFromRecentlyOpenedFiles
methods.description: Reads recently opened files' content as snippets with a timeout, excluding the current file.

methods.name: getAllSnippets
methods.description: Aggregates various snippets asynchronously with race conditions, returning a comprehensive payload.

methods.name: getAllSnippetsWithoutRace
methods.description: Aggregates snippets without race conditions, returning a comprehensive payload.
